cohort: The study included 176 small-for-gestational-age newborns in breech presentation delivered near term in five maternity hospitals in France between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Vaginal delivery of SGA fetuses in breech presentation was associated with lower arterial pH levels at birth and higher neonatal or NICU admissions compared to planned cesarean sections, with no significant difference in 5-minute Apgar scores.
